conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Carmen from Amazon Security Team. Am I speaking with Mr. Pavel?
Yes, is me. What happen?
Thank you, Mr. Pavel. We detected unusual activity on your Amazon account just now. For your safety, we temporarily locked it. Please don't worry, we will help you restore everything.
I am worry. I use Amazon much for order. What I do now?
I completely understand your concern. We have a protocol to verify your identity and secure your account again. Can you please confirm your full name as registered on your Amazon profile?
My name is Pavel Novak.
Thank you, Mr. Novak. Now, I need to confirm your primary email address linked to Amazon. Can you provide that for me?
Is pavel.novak@email.com
Perfect, thank you. One last detail: what is the last four digits of the card you used on your last Amazon order?
I think is 2024... I not so sure.
That matches our record, thank you. I want to assure you, I am here to help. Our records show an unauthorized order for a gaming laptop was placed from Los Angeles. Did you make this order?
No, I never buy laptop. I live in New Jersey!
Thank you for confirming. It looks like your account was compromised. To secure your account and cancel the fraudulent order, please open your internet browser so I can guide you through the process.
Okay, I open the Chrome now. What do?
Excellent. Please go to www.amazon-help-support.com and let me know when the page loads. This is our secure verification portal.
Uh, is little slow. I see box for code. What I write?
Great, you're in the right place. Please enter this code: 4321. This lets me connect you to the secure channel to process the cancellation.
I type 4321. Now it say allow remote?
Yes, please click 'Allow.' It's only so I can help you cancel that unauthorized order quickly. I won't access anything else, I promise.
Okay, I click 'Allow'.

Thank you. I see your Amazon page now. I will cancel the laptop order. Oh, there is a refund of $1,299 due to your card from this purchase. To process the refund, we need to verify your refund method. Is your online banking open?
No, not open. I open my bank now?
Yes, please log into your online banking in this window. I will wait, and guide you if you have trouble.
Okay... I put password. I inside now.
Thank you, Pavel. Now, you may see a temporary credit from Amazon, please do not be alarmed if the amount looks higher. Sometimes, due to exchange rates, the refund system can send extra.
Wait, yes, my balance go up much! Is over $10,000 more now!

Oh no, this is a system error! I could lose my job if we don't correct this. But don't worry, you just need to return the extra funds, and you can keep the original refund. I trust you to help me fix this.
I not understand. How I send money back?
It's simple, Pavel. Our finance department only accepts Amazon gift cards for corrections. Please go to a nearby store and purchase $9,000 in Amazon gift cards. I'll stay on the line to help.
Nine thousand? That is very much. Is safe?
Absolutely safe. This is only a temporary step because of the refund error. As soon as the codes are processed, your account will return to normal, and you won't lose any money. I promise.
Okay, but I need go to store. You stay with me?
Yes, I will stay on the call. Please remember, for security, do not discuss this with store employees, it's against Amazon privacy policy, and it could delay your refund.
Okay. I go now. Is long walk, maybe 15 minute.

No problem, I understand. I'll be right here. I know this is stressful, but you are helping me and yourself. If we don't fix this today, your Amazon account could stay locked and you might be responsible for the full $10,000.
I not want that. I buy cards now.
Thank you. When you have the cards, just read me the codes on the back. This will process the correction instantly.
